scripts.db:migrations:apply: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrations:apply:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrations:apply:staging: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrations:apply && npm run build:clean && npm run check:shim && env -u WORKER_BUILD_FEATURES npx wrangler deploy && npm run check:shim
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run db:migrations:apply:staging && npm run build:clean && npm run check:shim && env -u WORKER_BUILD_FEATURES npx wrangler deploy --env staging && npm run check:shim
